inventoryName: 1.6.6 Settings parity — original tabs with accordion sections

source.priorWebRouteExposureNote: The pre-4eb source registers /settings GET and /api/settings GET+POST; GET can page with offset/limit but no query returns the full catalog.
source.currentWebRouteExposure: disabled: /settings and /api/settings are not registered after 4eb9b811; Clippings handler not registered
source.interfaceFontDecision: Worker E commit ce86b9f8 disables custom UI font application and preserves selection; row is still present in this exact source and row-hide remains pending
source.homeWorkerOverlap: Theme value 5 remains the Folio Nooir Lite alias and uses the same featured synopsis, stats, and layout controls as Folio Nooir. Recent/Finished layouts are available under both Folio themes; the legacy Carousel field is retained for persistence/migration and replaced in the UI by those selectors. The saved Interface Font selection remains stored, while the row is hidden and the built-in UI font is used.
source.prototypeLayout: Original Display, Reader, Controls, and System tabs; lightweight accordion sections within each tab; Reading and Controls rows appear directly because each tab has one group; one currentGroupSettings vector is materialized for the selected group
source.webRouteStatus: Bounded Web Settings group/page routes are integrated on the current 1.6.6 branch (route 908453f39608169b1dad079e31a94db28415001b; integration 7296bbc85467675fdc8e1dffd4c73f4022e96518); Web Clippings/Notes remain disabled.
